statements.subject: server
statements.description: On receiving the SUBSCRIBE packet, the Broker MUST use the type of packet (i.e., SUBSCRIBE) and the Topic Filter in the packet header to match against the scope field of the stored token or introspection result.
actions: extract packet type (SUBSCRIBE) and Topic Filter from received packet header
match packet type and Topic Filter against scope field of stored token or introspection result

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The Topic Filters MUST be an exact match to or be a subset of at least one of the "topic_filter" fields in the scope array found in the Client's token.
actions: authorize Topic Filter only if it exactly matches or is a subset of at least one topic_filter field in the Client token scope array

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The Broker MAY return 0x80 (Unspecified error) if they do not want to leak the Topic Names to unauthorized clients.
actions: return 0x80 (Unspecified error) in SUBACK instead of 0x87 to avoid leaking Topic Names to unauthorized clients
